verses.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
verses.pt: Oxalá me suportásseis um pouco na minha insensatez! Sim, suportai-me ainda.
verses.en_web: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
verses.en_bbe: Put up with me if I am a little foolish: but, truly, you do put up with me.

verses.en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.pt: Porque estou zeloso de vós com zelo de Deus; pois vos desposei com um só Esposo, Cristo, para vos apresentar a ele como virgem pura.
verses.en_web: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For I have a very great care for you: because you have been married by me to one husband, and it is my desire to give you completely holy to Christ.

verses.en: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.pt: Mas temo que, assim como a serpente enganou a Eva com a sua astúcia, assim também sejam de alguma sorte corrompidos os vossos entendimentos e se apartem da simplicidade e da pureza que há em Cristo.
verses.en_web: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: But I have a fear, that in some way, as Eve was tricked by the deceit of the snake, your minds may be turned away from their simple and holy love for Christ.

verses.en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
verses.pt: Porque, se alguém vem e vos prega outro Jesus que nós não temos pregado, ou se recebeis outro espírito que não recebestes, ou outro evangelho que não abraçastes, de boa mente o suportais!
verses.en_web: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different “good news”, which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.
verses.en_bbe: For if anyone comes preaching another Jesus from the one whose preachers we are, or if you have got a different spirit, or a different sort of good news from those which came to you, how well you put up with these things.

verses.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.pt: Ora, julgo que em nada tenho sido inferior aos mais excelentes apóstolos.
verses.en_web: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
verses.en_bbe: For in my opinion, I am in no way less than the most important of the Apostles.

verses.en: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.pt: Pois ainda que seja rude na palavra, não o sou contudo na ciência; antes, por todos os modos, isto vos temos demonstrado em tudo.
verses.en_web: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
verses.en_bbe: But though I am rough in my way of talking, I am not so in knowledge, as we have made clear to all by our acts among you.

verses.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
verses.pt: Pequei porventura, humilhando-me a mim mesmo, para que vós fôsseis exaltados, porque de graça vos anunciei o evangelho de Deus?
verses.en_web: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
verses.en_bbe: Or did I do wrong in making myself low so that you might be lifted up, because I gave you the good news of God without reward?

verses.en: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
verses.pt: Outras igrejas despojei, recebendo delas salário, para vos servir;
verses.en_web: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
verses.en_bbe: I took money from other churches as payment for my work, so that I might be your servant;

verses.en: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
verses.pt: e quando estava presente convosco, e tinha necessidade, a ninguém fui pesado; porque os irmãos, quando vieram da Macedônia, supriram a minha necessidade; e em tudo me guardei, e ainda me guardarei, de vos ser pesado.
verses.en_web: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
verses.en_bbe: And when I was present with you, and was in need, I let no man be responsible for me; for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, gave me whatever was needed; and in everything I kept myself from being a trouble to you, and I will go on doing so.

verses.en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.pt: Como a verdade de Cristo está em mim, não me será tirada glória nas regiões da Acaia.
verses.en_web: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.en_bbe: As the true word of Christ is in me, I will let no man take from me this my cause of pride in the country of Achaia.

verses.en: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.pt: Por que? Será porque não vos amo? Deus o sabe.
verses.en_web: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
verses.en_bbe: Why? because I have no love for you? let God be judge.

verses.en: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.pt: Ora, o que faço e ainda farei, é para cortar ocasião aos que buscam ocasião; a fim de que, naquilo em que se gloriam, sejam achados assim como nós.
verses.en_web: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.
verses.en_bbe: But what I do, that I will go on doing, so that I may give no chance to those who are looking for one; so that, in the cause of their pride, they may be seen to be the same as we are.

verses.en: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
verses.pt: Pois os tais são falsos apóstolos, obreiros fraudulentos, disfarçando-se em apóstolos de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
verses.en_bbe: For such men are false Apostles, workers of deceit, making themselves seem like Apostles of Christ.

verses.en: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.pt: E não é de admirar, porquanto o próprio Satanás se disfarça em anjo de luz.
verses.en_web: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
verses.en_bbe: And it is no wonder; for even Satan himself is able to take the form of an angel of light.

verses.en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.pt: Não é muito, pois, que também os seus ministros se disfarcem em ministros da justiça; o fim dos quais será conforme as suas obras.
verses.en_web: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
verses.en_bbe: So it is no great thing if his servants make themselves seem to be servants of righteousness; whose end will be the reward of their works.

verses.en: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
verses.pt: Outra vez digo: ninguém me julgue insensato; mas se assim pensais, recebei-me como insensato mesmo, para que eu também me glorie um pouco.
verses.en_web: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
verses.en_bbe: I say again, Let me not seem foolish to anyone; but if I do, put up with me as such, so that I may take a little glory to myself.

verses.en: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.pt: O que digo, não o digo segundo o Senhor, mas como por insensatez, nesta confiança de gloriar-me.
verses.en_web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.en_bbe: What I am now saying is not by the order of the Lord, but as a foolish person, taking credit to myself, as it seems.

verses.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.pt: Desde que muitos se gloriam segundo a carne, eu também me gloriarei.
verses.en_web: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that there are those who take credit to themselves after the flesh, I will do the same.

verses.en: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
verses.pt: Porque, sendo vós sensatos, de boa mente tolerais os insensatos.
verses.en_web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
verses.en_bbe: For you put up with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.

verses.en: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.pt: Pois se alguém vos escraviza, se alguém vos devora, se alguém vos defrauda, se alguém se ensoberbece, se alguém vos fere no rosto, vós o suportais.
verses.en_web: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.
verses.en_bbe: You put up with a man if he makes servants of you, if he makes profit out of you, if he makes you prisoners, if he puts himself in a high place, if he gives you blows on the face.

verses.en: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.pt: Falo com vergonha, como se nós fôssemos fracos; mas naquilo em que alguém se faz ousado, com insensatez falo, também eu sou ousado.
verses.en_web: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
verses.en_bbe: I say this by way of shaming ourselves, as if we had been feeble. But if anyone puts himself forward (I am talking like a foolish person), I will do the same.

verses.en: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.pt: São hebreus? também eu; são israelitas? também eu; são descendência de Abraão? também eu;
verses.en_web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
verses.en_bbe: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they of Israel? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

verses.en: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.pt: são ministros de Cristo? falo como fora de mim, eu ainda mais; em trabalhos muito mais; em prisões muito mais; em açoites sem medida; em perigo de morte muitas vezes;
verses.en_web: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.
verses.en_bbe: Are they servants of Christ? (I am talking foolishly) I am more so; I have had more experience of hard work, of prisons, of blows more than measure, of death.

verses.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
verses.pt: dos judeus cinco vezes recebi quarenta açoites menos um.
verses.en_web: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.
verses.en_bbe: Five times the Jews gave me forty blows but one.

verses.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.pt: Três vezes fui açoitado com varas, uma vez fui apedrejado, três vezes sofri naufrágio, uma noite e um dia passei no abismo;
verses.en_web: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
verses.en_bbe: Three times I was whipped with rods, once I was stoned, three times the ship I was in came to destruction at sea, a night and a day I have been in the water;

verses.en: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.pt: em viagens muitas vezes, em perigos de rios, em perigos de salteadores, em perigos dos da minha raça, em perigos dos gentios, em perigos na cidade, em perigos no deserto, em perigos no mar, em perigos entre falsos irmãos;
verses.en_web: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
verses.en_bbe: In frequent travels, in dangers on rivers, in dangers from outlaws, in dangers from my countrymen, in dangers from the Gentiles, in dangers in the town, in dangers in the waste land, in dangers at sea, in dangers among false brothers;

verses.en: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.pt: em trabalhos e fadiga, em vigílias muitas vezes, em fome e sede, em jejuns muitas vezes, em frio e nudez.
verses.en_web: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: In hard work and weariness, in frequent watchings, going without food and drink, cold and in need of clothing.

verses.en: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
verses.pt: Além dessas coisas exteriores, há o que diariamente pesa sobre mim, o cuidado de todas as igrejas.
verses.en_web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: In addition to all the other things, there is that which comes on me every day, the care of all the churches.

verses.en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
verses.pt: Quem enfraquece, que eu também não enfraqueça? Quem se escandaliza, que eu me não abrase?
verses.en_web: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
verses.en_bbe: Who is feeble and I am not feeble? who is in danger of falling, and I am not angry?

verses.en: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
verses.pt: Se é preciso gloriar-me, gloriar-me-ei no que diz respeito à minha fraqueza.
verses.en_web: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
verses.en_bbe: If I have to take credit to myself, I will do so in the things in which I am feeble.

verses.en: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
verses.pt: O Deus e Pai do Senhor Jesus, que é eternamente bendito, sabe que não minto.
verses.en_web: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
verses.en_bbe: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be praise for ever, is witness that the things which I say are true.

verses.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
verses.pt: Em Damasco, o que governava sob o rei Aretas guardava a cidade dos damascenos, para me prender;
verses.en_web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
verses.en_bbe: In Damascus, the ruler under Aretas the king kept watch over the town of the people of Damascus, in order to take me:

verses.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.pt: mas por uma janela desceram-me num cesto, muralha abaixo; e assim escapei das suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.en_bbe: And being let down in a basket from the wall through a window, I got free from his hands.
